title: $\Dic(X,\Lambda)$ is a triangulated subcategory
statement:
Let $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$. $\Dic(X,\Lambda)$ contains $0$, is closed under shifts in both directions and
under isomorphisms, and if $K\to L\to M\to K[1]$ is a distinguished triangle in $\D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$
with two of $K,L,M$ in $\Dic(X,\Lambda)$, then so is the third. Hence $\Dic(X,\Lambda)$ is a full
triangulated subcategory.

Here $\ell$ is a prime, $k$ is a field of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and $X$ is a separated finite-type $k$-scheme in the standing setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]; $\Qlb$ is an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $E\subseteq\Qlb$ is a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. The coefficient ring is the pulled-back condensed ring $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\underline\Lambda$, as in [def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-ring] and [def-sfb-qlbar-coefficient-ring], and $\Mod(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)=\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$ is the category of module objects of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. The ambient $\D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)=D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$ is the ordinary derived category [pur713-def-module-category], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\Cons(X,\Lambda)$ for the constructible modules of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. The full subcategory $\IndCons(X,\Lambda)$ consists of modules isomorphic to small filtered colimits, computed in $\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$, of objects of $\Cons(X,\Lambda)$. Finally,
$$
\Dic(X,\Lambda)=\{K\in D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X}) : H^n(K)\in\IndCons(X,\Lambda)\text{ for every }n\in\mathbf Z\}.
$$
Full triangulated subcategory has the meaning of [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory].

proof.text: For any commutative condensed coefficient ring, the zero module has a finite constant local model: use the identity cover, the zero condensed module, and its presentation as the cokernel of the identity of the rank-zero free module. The singleton stratification makes every zero module finite constant stratified. Unfold the affine-local alternative of IsConstantModelConstructible to obtain the same assertion on general schemes, using that restriction preserves zero. The one-object filtered presentation embeds this zero object in ObjectProperty.ind.

proof.text: For each canonical coefficient, apply indHeart_kernelsCokernels. Its last two conjuncts give the chosen ambient kernels and cokernels of maps between ind-constructible objects. Transport from these chosen limits and colimits to any kernel fork or cokernel cofork by the canonical universal-property isomorphisms. These supply ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderKernels and IsClosedUnderCokernels for the replete ind property.

proof.text: The finite-type scheme over the field is locally Noetherian, and the quasi-compact structure map to the affine field spectrum makes it compact. Apply indConstructible_of_shortExact and indConstructible_of_shortExact_padicAlgCl to supply ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderExtensions for the two coefficient rings. ObjectProperty.ind is automatically closed under isomorphisms.

proof.text: Apply the proved general declaration DerivedCategory.homologyProperty_isTriangulated recorded on prop-constructible-derived-subcategory. Its cohomological weak Serre class argument supplies zero, shifts and triangle closure from exactly the preceding hypotheses. Internally it constructs the cokernel/kernel short exact sequence from the five-term long exact cohomology sequence and obtains all triangle cases by the triangulated object-property API. Thus this is the same unit-level ind-heart route, with its generic homological algebra reused rather than reimplemented. The resulting property is definitionally the predicate in each conjunct of indConstructibleDerived_isTriangulated.

lean.statement: theorem indConstructibleDerived_isTriangulated (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) (hpl : p ≠ ℓ) (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] : ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated (fun K : DerivedCategory (CategoryTheory.Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ E)) ↦ ∀ n : ℤ, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X) ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj K)) ∧ ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated (fun K : DerivedCategory (CategoryTheory.Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicAlgClRingObj X ℓ)) ↦ ∀ n : ℤ, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X) ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj K))
